bh-s02.css:
font-family: var(--Poppins); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--PureBlack);
@media(--laptop) { line-height: 100%; }

bh-s08.css: &:hover { border-color: rgba(3,103,161,0.3); box-shadow: 0px 10px 24px 0px rgba(3,103,161,0.10); } text-decoration: none; padding: 1.2rem; border-radius: 16px; border-width: 1px; border-color: rgba(3,103,161,0.1); border-style: solid; background-color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0px 2px 12px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) inset; transition: box-shadow 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px;

bh-s09.css: padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 15px; align-items: center;

bh-s10.css: width: 42px; height: 42px; object-fit: contain; flex: 0 0 auto;

font-family: var(--Poppins); font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; color: var(--PureBlack); line-height: 1.3;

bh-s16.css: width: 100%; position: relative; background-color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; align-items: center;

bh-s31.css:
font-family: var(--Poppins); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; color: var(--DarkGray);
@media(--mobile) { text-align: center; }

bh-s33.css: color: #4F4F4F; padding-inline-start: 26px; margin: 0px; background-image: url("https://medcaredemo.online/medcare/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check-icon-green.svg"); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-attachment: scroll; background-size: 16px auto; background-position: 0% 0%; background-position: left 4px; & strong { color: #000000; font-weight: 500; }

&:hover { box-shadow: 0px 10px 24px 0px rgba(3,103,161,0.10); transform: translate3d(0px, -3px, 0px); } padding: 2rem; border-radius: 30px; background-color: #EBF6FF; transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
@media(--tablet_extra) { padding: 1.5rem; }

bh-s40.css: font-family: var(--Poppins); font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; color: #000000; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0px;

bh-s41.css: width: 14px; padding: 0px; transition: transform 0.25s; display: flex; flex: 0 0 auto; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center;

bh-s43.css:
padding-block-start: 20px; padding-block-end: 20px; padding-inline-start: 26px; padding-inline-end: 26px;
@media(--mobile) { padding-block-start: 16px; padding-block-end: 16px; padding-inline-start: 10px; padding-inline-end: 10px; }
